description.value: Vennie's Sub Shop is a community-focused sandwich spot started in 2021 by a group of friends devoted to hand-crafted subs, now operating out of a physical location near the top of Commercial Drive in Vancouver. The menu spans creative cold subs like The Muffaletta (mortadella, salami, giardiniera) and hot options such as a French Beef Dip and Chopped Cheese, alongside sides and cookies. The shop also offers event catering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at vennies.ca confirms an active physical business opened in 2021 near Commercial Drive, consistent with the OSM address at 1692 Venables Street. Takeout is confirmed by OSM tag `takeaway=yes`. The menu page lists 'The Veggie' sub (Roast Zucchini, Tomato, Arugula, Fior di latte, Pesto Mayo, Balsamic Glaze), confirming at least one vegetarian option. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Website header renders the name as 'Vennies Sub Shop' (no apostrophe), while OSM uses 'Vennie's Sub Shop'. Minor typographic discrepancy; likely the same business.
No street address appears explicitly on the website to cross-confirm the OSM address of 1692 Venables Street.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sandwich shop with a confirmed website and recent OSM check date (2024-01-13). Useful stop for touring cyclists near Commercial Drive.
